description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Order under Section 57 of the Banking (Special Provisions) Act. No. 17 of 2023
categorisation: This gazette contains an order made under the Banking (Special Provisions) Act, No. 17 of 2023, extending banking resolution provisions to finance companies. This constitutes a regulatory framework and legal instrument issued by the Central Bank, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
